{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy dampener''' was a device that could be used to modify a blaster. It reduced the visibility of blaster shots, but also weakened their power.<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>
